name: Bhasha Bridge
description: Multilingual course content translator (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT) powered by IBM Granite on watsonx.ai. IBM SkillsBuild AICTE-2026, Problem Statement #17.

WATSONX_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud API key (IBM Cloud > Manage > Access (IAM) > API keys). Leave empty to run in labelled DEMO MODE.

WATSONX_PROJECT_ID.description: watsonx.ai project ID (project > Manage > General). The project must be linked to a watsonx.ai Runtime in the same region.

WATSONX_URL.description: Regional endpoint of your watsonx.ai Runtime, e.g. https://eu-de.ml.cloud.ibm.com (must match your project's region).

DEMO_MODE.description: Set to true to force labelled demo mode (no IBM calls).
